{{Quote|In recognition of your status as a Galladinium Preferred Customer, the following items are being offered to you exclusively through this special datalog edition. These items will not appear in our standard merchandise datalog available to the general public.|[[Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology|''Galladinium's Datalog'']]|<ref name="Galladinium's Fantastic Technology">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>}}
A '''Galladinium Preferred Customer''' was a customer of the catalog ''[[Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology]]'' that deserved special treatment by [[Galladinium Galactic Exports|Galladinium]]'s staff. Those Customers were offered, at a high price, non-standard merchandise that was unavailable for the rest of the public, including:
*[[Abyssin grafting patch]]
*[[ACCA-1dx000]]
*[[Barabel microbe armor]]
*[[Chestrashi void spear]]
*[[Columi Mental Hoverpod]]
*[[Duros Bio-Comp 1000]]
*[[Implant communicator]]
*[[MagnaForce security shield]]
*[[Personal Combat Threat Analyzer]]
*[[Repulsor throwing razor/Legends|Repulsor throwing razor]]
*[[Sun jammer]]
*[[Tensor rifle]]
*[[TRHA-300 Control Harness]]
*[[Verpine shatter gun]]
